packages.name: Cloudflare DNS Updater
packages.description: Updates an existing Cloudflare A or AAAA record with the hub's current public IP using a scoped API token. Update-only — never creates new records.

packages.name: DMS Monitor (Dead Man's Snitch)
packages.description: Sends scheduled heartbeat pings to Dead Man's Snitch to confirm that the Hubitat hub and internet connection are alive.

packages.name: DNS Made Easy Updater
packages.description: Updates a DNS Made Easy A record with your public IP using Hubitat.

packages.name: SignalBricks Integration
packages.description: Syncs OwnerRez booking door codes from the SignalBricks dispatcher to Hubitat locks. Runs alongside the OwnerRez app; each app needs its own different, non-empty code name prefix (e.g. OwnerRez "G:", SignalBricks "GT:"). Codes are named <prefix>ORB<booking id>-<guest> and exist from before check-in to after checkout. Never touches codes without ORB<booking id> in the name, or SignalBricks Telemetry's SBA:/SBM: slots.

packages.name: SignalBricks Telemetry
packages.description: Sends read-only lock, contact, temperature, humidity and battery events to SignalBricks; telemetry never sends lock PINs. Optional, off-by-default lock code management for admin and managed codes.
